title: Slack MCP: Connect MCP Servers to an AI Agent in Slack

facts.fact: Runbear's Slack MCP page says each AI agent can use Claude, GPT, or Gemini models, running on the default Claude Agent SDK runtime.
facts.quote: Choose Claude, GPT, or Gemini for each agent on the default Claude Agent SDK runtime.

facts.fact: Runbear says MCP servers can be connected from its managed catalog with OAuth, or any remote MCP server reachable over HTTPS can be added using Streamable HTTP or SSE.
facts.quote: Connect servers from Runbear's managed catalog with OAuth, or add any remote MCP server reachable over HTTPS with Streamable HTTP or SSE.

facts.fact: Runbear says a tool can be connected in Per-User mode, so the agent acts with each member's own permissions, or in Shared mode, with one account for everyone.
facts.quote: Connect a tool Per-User, so the agent acts with each member's own permissions, or Shared, with one account for everyone.

facts.fact: Runbear's Slack MCP page describes setting up MCP-enabled AI in Slack as three steps.
facts.quote: Get started with MCP-enabled AI in Slack in three simple steps

facts.fact: Runbear's Slack MCP page offers a 'Get Started for Free' call to action, without stating a price or free-tier limits.
facts.quote: Get Started for Free[Or, book a demo](https://runbear.io/demo)

facts.fact: Runbear's page lists Matillion, Fireflies.ai, BCG, Minted, Mercor, Tabs, TaxDome, Peak Ace, Storykit, and SYPartners as teams already running Runbear.
